signed_gain_regression.details: Each actual gain is trained by half-MSE; the two or three terms are averaged. There is no query hinge, signed margin, target-dependent weight or cost-offset label. Raw-gradient fixtures equal(prediction-target)/n. Existing inference retains STOP0 and gain-lambda*token_cost.

pairing_and_gradient.details: Selected-extra minus same-role sampled predictions and gains are compared by half-MSE. Both prediction gradients remain connected, equal/opposite; the unrelated modality has zero pair gradient.32 role/kind combinations pass. The common primary IoU cancels algebraically; floating arithmetic still uses the actual signed gain labels.

ties_no_extra_and_anchor.details: Tie targets drive the predicted difference to0. No-extra gives0 pair loss and exactly two candidate-gain calls. A common nonzero gain shift leaves pair loss0 but yields positive raw regression, so the pair-only offset ambiguity is removed.32 exact-target,10 tie/negative/zero/anchor and8 no-extra fixtures pass.

quality_and_existing_pipeline.details: Quality AST and32 value/gradient checks are unchanged. Counts,causal batch,selected-target replay,checkpoint/freeze/probe and label writer are AST-identical. Main and trajectory loop match after removing new description/logging only. All49 prior source hashes remain exact. No additional model/teacher calls or new parameters/labels are introduced.

scalar_mean_fixture.details: For the preceding Bernoulli(.25) scalar example, half-MSE has derivative0 at.25 and positive derivative.0458333 at the old hinge optimum.2958333, whose new risk is higher.

joint_common_state_mean_fixture.details: Twelve correlated-joint-label cases verify zero gradient at conditional means, the analytic Hessian and60 risk decompositions. For fixed common state/candidate/selection, expected risk excess is||p-mu||^2/(2n)+.5*(a^T(p-mu))^2 when paired. Positive raw anchoring makes the scored mean vector the unique unrestricted minimizer. No independence between labels is required.

claim_limits.details: Condition on the same complete state and fixed candidate/selection event; raw and pair targets must share one joint distribution with finite second moments and positive label-independent raw weights. The proof assumes freely specifiable common-state predictions. Different per-query information, finite shared parameters, shared-CNN quality loss, changing online sampling and imperfect optimization are outside it. No finite-network/population calibration or tracking-improvement guarantee.

common_state_assumptions: Fix common conditioning state and observed candidate set/selection.
The same joint label distribution supplies raw and pair labels, with finite second moments.
Raw regression weights are positive and independent of realized labels conditional on that state.
Predictions may vary freely over the common state; actual finite shared networks need not meet this condition.
deterministic_verification.guarantee_excluded: No finite-network, differing-input-information, optimization, online-selection or population calibration guarantee.
